entries.description: Stdio MCP server exposing four tools: create_inbox, list_messages, read_message, wait_for_code. Spawn disposable inboxes and collect verification (OTP) codes without a browser.
representativeQueries: wait for the verification code sent to this address
read the OTP from a temporary inbox
run an MCP server for disposable email

entries.description: Agent skill: install and drive the tossinbox CLI or MCP server to receive signup and verification emails, extract OTP codes, and delete the inbox afterwards.
representativeQueries: get a throwaway email address for this signup
receive an OTP without exposing my real inbox
